transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’ve been… hearing things. People talking about me, mostly at work. Through the conference room walls, or sometimes from my phone even when it’s off. It sounds like board members or staff saying I’m ruining the company. It’s clear enough that I’ve answered them, and then… realized no one else heard anything.
Are the voices you're hearing the only unusual perceptions you're experiencing, or are you seeing, smelling, tasting, or feeling things that aren't there as well?

Mostly just the voices. I mean… I keep hearing people talking about me, like through the conference room walls, or from my phone when it’s off. It sounds like board members or staff saying I’m ruining things. It’s clear enough that I’ve answered before realizing nobody else heard it.
Do you ever feel like your own thoughts are not really your own?
I don’t know… I haven’t really noticed that. My thoughts feel like mine, I think.
Do you believe what the voices are saying about you is true?
I… I don’t know. Sometimes it feels like they must know something, but I’m not sure. It’s hard to tell.
Do you find it hard to organize your thoughts or make decisions lately?

Yes… lately it’s been harder. I used to make those decisions quickly, at work, but now I just… stall. Things don’t get finished. Some of the senior staff have been handling things I normally would, without really saying much about it.

At home it’s similar. My husband has been doing most of it because I either don’t start things or I leave them halfway done.
Have you noticed any changes in your behavior, like doing things that don't make sense or having trouble completing tasks?

Yes… I guess so. In meetings, or at gallery events, I’ll suddenly get up and start moving pens or name cards around, like into patterns. Sometimes I repeat something someone just said, or… hold my hands up like I’m presenting something.

At the time it feels like I need to do it, but afterward I know it didn’t really make sense.
Do the voices you're hearing happen all the time, or do they come and go?

They come and go… but it’s often enough that I came in because of it. I’ll hear them through the conference room walls, or sometimes from my phone when it’s off. It sounds like board members or staff talking about me, saying I’m ruining the company. It’s… clear enough that I answer before I realize no one else heard anything.
Do you find yourself having trouble expressing your thoughts in a way that makes sense to others?
I’m… not really sure. I know I don’t always explain things as clearly as I used to, but I haven’t paid much attention to how it sounds to other people.
Do you often find yourself jumping from one topic to another while talking, without finishing what you started to say?
I don’t know. Maybe sometimes, but I’m not really tracking it when I’m talking. People do ask me to slow down or start over sometimes… but I can’t say exactly.
Do you feel like your thoughts are disconnected from each other when you're trying to explain something?
I’m not sure. It doesn’t feel disconnected to me exactly… I just lose track of how I’m saying it sometimes. I don’t really know how to explain that.
Do you feel like your thoughts are disjointed or hard to put into words when you're trying to communicate with others?
I don’t really know. Sometimes it’s hard to get it out right, but I can’t tell if it’s my thoughts or just… the words not coming the way I mean.
Do you often find it hard to stay on one topic when talking to someone?
I don’t know… I guess sometimes. I’m not really noticing it while I’m talking. If someone points it out, then maybe, but it’s hard for me to tell.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to enjoy?

Yeah… I think so. I used to really care about work, ideas, following up with people after openings and things like that. Now I can sit at my desk staring at an agenda for hours and just… not feel much. I don’t talk much at home or at work either.
Have you been feeling emotionally flat or indifferent to things that would normally upset or excite you?

Yeah… I guess flat is the word. Things that used to make me move, like work or the openings, calling people, pushing ideas… I just sit there now, staring at the agenda for hours. I don’t really feel upset or excited. I barely talk to my husband or the staff. It’s just… not much there.
Do you feel like your thoughts are racing or speeding by when you're trying to think or talk?
I’m not sure. I don’t really notice them speeding up… mostly I just have trouble saying things clearly sometimes. I don’t know if that’s the same.
Have your symptoms been causing problems for you at work or in your relationships?

Yes… it has. Work especially. I’m not really keeping up with running the division anymore, not like I should. Some of the senior staff have sort of… stepped in and taken over things I used to handle.

At home, my husband does most of it now. I leave things half-done, or I just don’t start them. I don’t really like talking about it, but… yes, it’s causing problems.
Have you been having trouble maintaining your daily routine and completing everyday tasks on your own?

Yes… I don’t really keep up with things on my own anymore.

At work, I’m not reliably making the decisions or running the division the way I used to. People have sort of… taken things over, without saying much. And at home, my husband handles most of it now because I leave things unfinished, or I just don’t start them.
Do you believe the voices are telling the truth about you ruining the company?
I… I don’t know. It feels true when I hear it. They sound like board members or staff, saying I’m ruining the company, and it’s so clear sometimes I answer before I realize no one else heard it.
Do the voices and other symptoms you're experiencing happen every day?

Yes… pretty much every day. It’s usually the voices—like people talking about me through the conference room walls, or sometimes from my phone even when it’s off. It sounds like board members or staff saying I’m ruining the company. It’s… very clear sometimes.
Do the voices and your other symptoms stay the same, or do they change over time?

It hasn’t really stayed the same. It’s… built up over time.

I guess it started around the company expansion, when I was put in charge of that new arts-and-commerce division. That was… about two years and four months ago. Since then it’s gotten harder to ignore.
